title: DevBytes
description: AI-based 60-word news summarizer app made for people in tech, by people in tech. An innovative idea for GDG Solutions Challenge 2025 in association with GDG on Campus IEC.

title: TrackTik
description: A location-based alarm app that wakes you up 30 minutes before reaching your destination. Developed in collaboration with ProTecGames, this app helps travelers never miss their stops.

title: SunoSynth - AI Music Maker
description: AI music maker available for both Android (Flutter) and Web (NextJS) with backends in Python and Node.js. Features include AI music generation, AI lyrics writing, cross-platform account access, and custom instructions.

title: VerboVisions: Text to Image
description: Android app that lets users create images using AI. This application transforms text descriptions into visual art through advanced machine learning algorithms.

title: HTML Editor PRO
description: Professional HTML editor with real-time collaboration, website hosting, syntax highlighting, and AI code generation. Features include project sharing, code prediction, and multiple themes.

title: PizzaVerse - Restaurant App
description: Full-stack restaurant app with features like ordering pizza, adding new pizza types, managing categories, and modern UI with sorting functionality. Built for IEC College of Engineering and Technology.
